release_notes: Pulse Glass 141 (rp-mtnzjxi3-kkbrk) is now registered as an experimental moor.render/1 WebGL2 challenger for moor.city.island.
The challenger draws through a separate WebGL2 surface while the Legacy Three renderer object remains intact for gameplay/input compatibility and instant rollback.
Renderer Pulls RUN is bridged to the Pulse Glass adapter and writes its first real 0-100 score only from measurements collected on your City Island runtime.

Telemetry includes frame p95/p99, renderer CPU p95, draw calls, triangles, resource/upload bytes, errors, scene coverage, unsupported-object count, and mandatory moor.render telemetry fields; unavailable GPU timing is explicitly reported UNAVAILABLE.
RenderReplay delegates to the City replay service when present and reports unsupported when that service is absent.

Pulse Glass v0.1.1 does not yet fully implement textures, shadows, sprites/LOD, BatchedMesh, transparent multi-material fidelity, or fog; coverage penalties cap its score rather than hiding missing presentation features.
32.1.1 supersedes the transient 32.1.0 package and uses byte-verified immutable renderer modules.
